title: Correction to the article "Global well-posedness and scattering in weighted space for nonlinear Schrödinger equations below the Strauss exponent without gauge-invariance"
summary: This article resolves some errors in the paper ``Global well-posedness and scattering in weighted space for nonlinear Schrödinger equations below the Strauss exponent without gauge-invariance. Math. Ann. 392, 1051-1097 (2025)''. The errors are in the proof of contraction of a map associated with our equation in two and three dimensions.
